notes: The visualizer and big-screen windows no longer keep a hidden titlebar strip along their top edge. Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.39.1.

win.notes: Plays MIDI and tracker modules (mod/s3m/xm/it) via in-app synthesis — real SoundFont banks and the OpenMPT engine, rendered in the page and verified on Windows. The radio grows WORLD/FAVS/LIST/PICKS tabs: a 400-station directory, a lossless FLAC section, and a starter dial of stream-checked greats. Plus playlist keyboard control, Track Info tabs with the module’s own words, a 1.5× size, right-click Arrange, OS file-type registration, and BIG mode’s DROP toggle.

linux.notes: The playlist grows a record crate: point Lib at a music folder and browse it as artists and albums — artwork grid, a filter box over every view, one-click album adds — with the folder watched so new rips just appear. CUE-sheet album rips play as their real tracks, gaplessly. BIG opens in the speakers room (DROP is opt-in) and the stack snaps into place. Plus Ctrl +/− steps the 1×/1½×/2× sizes from any window.
